name: Armadillo Amulet
description: The Armadillo Amulet is a talisman that reduces the cooldown time on rolling.

name: Essence of Efficiency
description: The Essence of Efficiency is a talisman that decreases artifact cooldowns.

name: Fist of Iron
description: The Fist of Iron is a talisman that increases all melee attack damage.

name: Golem Kit
description: The Golem Kit is a talisman that summons an iron golem to fight alongside the hero as a companion.

name: Healing Heart
description: The Healing Heart is a talisman that regenerates health when out of combat.

name: Lucky Clover
description: The Lucky Clover is a talisman that increases the odds of enemies dropping extra loot if they dropped loot.

name: Looter's Charm
description: The Looter's Charm is a talisman that increases the odds of enemies dropping loot.

name: Medallion of Momentum
description: The Medallion of Momentum is a talisman that increases movement speed after continuously moving for several seconds.

name: Ocelot's Paw
description: The Ocelot's Paw is a talisman that boosts jump attack damage.

name: Prickle's Mark
description: The Prickle's Mark is a talisman that summons a prickle to fight alongside the hero as a companion.

name: Sigil of Beeswax
description: The Sigil of Beeswax is a talisman that boosts the hero's health.

name: Tasty Bone
description: The Tasty Bone is a talisman that summons a wolf to fight alongside the hero.

name: Tendrils of the Sprout
description: The Tendrils of the Sprout is a sprout-inspired talisman that increases damage output.

name: The Eye of Experience
description: The Eye of Experience is a talisman that increases the experience gained by heroes.

name: Thrifty Pendant
description: The Thrifty Pendant is a talisman that grants a conditional damage boost based on the hero's emerald count.

name: Twig of Dark Oak
description: The Twig of Dark Oak is a talisman grants the hero more ammo.

name: Twisted Tooth
description: The Twisted Tooth is a talisman that increases the user's soul input.
